svg.title: Stripe Subscription Billing & Webhook Flow
svg.desc: Developer UI initiates Stripe checkout, webhook fires on successful payment, Express parses and updates PostgreSQL and Redis.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the Developer UI send to initiate a Stripe purchase?')
sendPrompt('How does Stripe Checkout Session work?')
sendPrompt('How does Stripe webhook signature verification work?')
sendPrompt('What fields in PostgreSQL user profile are updated after payment?')
sendPrompt('How does the Redis API-key cache get updated with new limits?')
